review_comments_data.body: @lilitkarapetyan - there is a mistake in the below code.  It is setting `roles` for every force - they all get given the new set of roles.  So, if I delete a `blue` role, the new list of roles gets stored for `white` and `red`, too.

Steps to reproduce:
- login as admin
- open `Small wargame`
- open `forces`
- open `White` then `roles`
- view 4 roles
- now open `Blue-1` roles
- delete `CT5-B5`
- click `Save Force`
- view `White` then `roles
- now see there is just the `CO` role for `White` (there should be 4 of them)
- also see it's the same single role for `Red`, too.

IMHO, `deleteRolesParticipations` should receive a `force-id` and `role-id` - so it can remove the correct `role` from the correct `force`.

@lilitkarapetyan - I'm trying to tidy the logic here.  The above `deleteRolesParticipations` returns two different types of result, which gets handled in two different ways.  (`handleChange` and `setCurrentWargame`).  Can you explain why there are to different paths followed?
HandleChange for real-time update roles, setCurrentWargame for live update wargame. They are needed to work properly.

i think I need to understand this a bit more.  We only call `deleteSelectedRole` from one place. What are the two separate paths? 

I've rewritten `deleteRolesParticipations`, but it is always returning the updated wargame.

Can you explain what the above line is doing?

`forces` is the full list of forces in the game.

We don't put the full list of forces into the `participants` of every channel.

issues.title: Clean channels on delete role or force
issues.body:
We popup a dialog when deleting a role or force.

If the Game Designer "commits" to the change then we should clean that role/force out of the channel definitions as follows:
- if a force is being deleted, delete `participations` for that force in any channel.  If there are no remaining participations, delete the channel.
- if a role is being deleted, delete that role from any participations for that force in any channel.  If there are no remaining roles for the participation, delete the participation. If there are no remaining participations, delete the channel.
